functions.signature: PatchNewInput(Target, Expected Duration Per Render, Out Sample Rate, Out Num Channels)

functions.name: SetNewSettings
functions.docs:
Post new settings for this endpoint.
There is no type safety on this call, so make sure that you are using the correct implementation
of IAudioEndpointSettingsProxy for this implementation of IAudioEndpoint.

functions.name: ProcessAudioIfNeccessary
functions.docs: If this audio endpoint hasn't spawned a seperate callback thread but requires a callback, this should be executed somewhere.

functions.name: IsImplemented
functions.docs: Whether this endpoint is of an implemented type

functions.name: GetEndpointTypeName
functions.docs: Get the name for the endpoint type that this factory produces.

functions.name: GetTypeNameForDefaultEndpoint
functions.docs: This is a special cased name for endpoint submixes that render directly to the default audio device in Audio::FMixerDevice::OnProcessAudioStream.

functions.name: GetModularFeatureName
functions.docs:
This is used when calling IModularFeatures::Get().RegisterModularFeature for IAudioEndpointFactory implementations.
It's not needed if one uses RegisterEndpointType() to register IAudioEndpointFactory implementations.

functions.name: RegisterEndpointType
functions.docs:
This needs to be called to make a soundfield format usable by the engine.
It can be called from a ISoundfieldFactory subclass' constructor

functions.name: UnregisterEndpointType
functions.docs:
This needs to be called it an implementation of ISoundfieldFactory is about to be destroyed.
It can be called from the destructor of an implementation of ISoundfieldFactory.

functions.docs: Called for every new endpoint submix created with this factory's endpoint type.

functions.docs: Should return the StaticClass of this factory's implementation of UAudioEndpointSettingsBase.
